newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France to hike pass. fares from Nov 4.
newsitem.headline: Air France to hike pass. fares from Nov 4.

text.p: Air France said on Friday it is increasing passenger fares on all flights from France with effect from Monday November 4.
In a statement the company linked the decision to a rise of some 40 percent in fuel costs.
The fare hike will be limited to one percent for flights to Europe and North-Africa. All fares to Asian destinations will increase by 2.5 percent, it said
For American destinations the increase will range from two to five percent, depending on the destination and the passenger class chosen.
All fares to the Middle-East will increase by three percent while fares to Africa will rise by four to five percent, depending on the passenger class.
Air France said it had not yet decided on the level of fares it would apply to French territories overseas nor when the new fares would apply.
